name: cf
title: Cloudflare API
description: Secure Cloudflare API wrapper. Use cf curl to call any endpoint without exposing the api_token.
author: cicy-ai

zh-CN.title: Cloudflare API
zh-CN.description: 安全的 Cloudflare API 包装器。通过 cf curl 调用任意端点，不向 Agent 暴露 api_token。

tools.name: cf status
tools.description: Show Cloudflare API config status (token masked)
tools.prompt: 运行 cf status 查看 Cloudflare API 配置状态

tools.name: cf curl
tools.description: Call any Cloudflare API endpoint with injected auth token
tools.prompt: 用 cf curl GET /zones 列出我的所有 Cloudflare zone

tools.name: cf exec
tools.description: Run a child process with CLOUDFLARE_API_TOKEN injected
tools.prompt: 用 cf exec 注入 token 后部署：cf exec npx wrangler deploy

tools.name: cf config
tools.description: Open config file in editor to set api_token / account_id
tools.prompt: 运行 cf config 配置 Cloudflare API token
